 MP Police Driver Salary 2026: Check In-Hand Salary, Basic Pay, Allowances & Benefits
 By Bebo Rani Last Updated: Oct 19, 2026, 12:56 IST MP Police Driver Salary 2026: MP Police Constable Driver posts offer a pay scale of ₹19,500 to ₹62,000 per month. Trainees get a 70%, 80%, and 90% stipend over three years. Check this article to get complete details about its in-hand salary, basic pay, and more.
 MP Police Driver Salary 2026: Check In-Hand Salary, Basic Pay, Allowances & Benefits Key Points
 MP Police Constable Driver pay scale is ₹19,500-₹62,000, with probation stipends.
 Applications for 1,000 Constable Driver posts open Oct 15-29, 2026.
 Confirmed constables receive DA, HRA, TA, and other government benefits.
 MP Police Driver Salary 2026: The Madhya Pradesh Police Constable Driver post is a popular choice among candidates who want a stable government job in the police department. Every year, thousands of youngsters apply for this role through the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (ESB). Along with respect and job security, the salary and benefits attract many aspirants. In this article to know about the MP Police Constable Driver salary 2026 in detail along with the pay scale, pay level, in-hand salary, allowances, and other benefits.  
 MP Police Constable Driver Salary 2026 Overview 
 The Madhya Pradesh Police Constable (Driver) recruitment is a regular state government job with a good pay scale. The table below gives the key facts about the recruitment and the salary; check this before applying. 
 Particulars 
 Details 
 Recruiting Body 
 Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB / MPPEB) 
 Department 
 Police Headquarters, Home (Police) Department, Govt. of MP 
 Post Name 
 Constable (Driver) 
 Total Vacancies 
 1,000 Posts (SAF: 200 | District Police Force: 800) 
 Job Type 
 Permanent, State Cadre 
 Gender Eligibility 
 Male Candidates Only 
 Pay Scale (7th Pay Matrix) 
 ₹19,500 – ₹62,000 per month (Starting Basic Pay: ₹19,500) 
 Probation Stipend Structure 
 1st Year: 70% | 2nd Year: 80% | 3rd Year: 90% of minimum pay scale + allowances 
 Application Window 
 15 October 2026 to 29 October 2026 (Form Correction up to 03 November 2026) 
 Selection Process 
 Written Exam (CBT) Physical Test (PET/PMT) Trade Test (Driving) DV & Medical 
 Official Website 
 esb.mp.gov.in 
 MP Police Driver Salary 2026 
 The MP Police Constable Driver salary is fixed in the pay scale of ₹19,500 to ₹62,000 per month, with a starting basic pay of ₹19,500. During the first three years, selected candidates receive a stipend of 70%, 80% and 90% of the minimum pay, which comes to about ₹13,650, ₹15,600 and ₹17,550 respectively. After confirmation, full pay applies along with DA, HRA, and other allowances. Job portals estimate the gross monthly salary at roughly ₹26,000 to ₹35,000, depending on the posting location.  
 MP Police Driver In-Hand Salary 2026 
 The in-hand salary is the amount a constable actually receives each month after deductions such as NPS contribution and professional tax. The official notification gives only the pay scale and the stipend percentages, not a fixed in-hand figure. The amounts below are therefore approximate and will vary with the posting location and the allowances applicable.

 ~₹28,000 – ₹35,000 
 Maximum Pay Scale

 ₹75,000+ 
 MP Police Constable Driver Salary Per Month 2026 
 The MP Police Constable Driver monthly salary starts at ₹19,500 basic pay and can rise to ₹62,000 with increments. During the three training years, the monthly stipend is about ₹13,650, ₹15,600, and ₹17,550. After confirmation, DA, HRA and other allowances are added to the basic pay. The gross monthly salary is estimated at ₹26,000 to ₹35,000, depending on the posting location. Senior constables with higher pay and allowances can earn around ₹75,000 or more per month, as per job portals. 
 MP Police Driver Allowances and Benefits 2026 
 Besides the basic pay, confirmed constables receive several allowances and benefits that raise the monthly salary. The exact amounts depend on the posting location and the rates the MP Government approves from time to time. The notification lists no fixed figures, so the details below are general. 
 Allowances 
 Dearness Allowance (DA): Paid on basic pay to offset inflation and revised by the government periodically. 
 House Rent Allowance (HRA): Depends on the city or town of posting. 
 Travel Allowance (TA): Paid for official travel and duty. 
 Other allowances: Other government allowances may apply as approved by the state. 
 Benefits 
 Job security: It is a permanent, regular state government post. 
 Career growth: Regular increments take the pay up to ₹62,000, and promotions follow departmental rules. 
 Uniform and duty facilities: Police personnel receive these as per department norms. 
 Government service perks: These include leave and retirement benefits under state rules.
